provenance: co-authored (Kavik + Claude), 2026-11-03. Seeded from docs/black_start_workforce_dependency_gap.md. Every unknown number is null with volume thin. Dependencies are DERIVED unless an item says otherwise.

items.name: Space heat
items.function: Keep occupants and pipes above freezing / hypothermia limits through a northern winter
items.non_grid_substitute: Wood, coal or propane stove / furnace (passive fallback removed by code, insurance and lending in some households)
items.local_holder: Households keeping wood or propane heat; firewood suppliers
items.trigger: threshold: indoor temperature below set point
items.note: Hours-to-fail depends on outdoor temperature and envelope; not measured here.

items.name: Potable water
items.function: Drinking and cooking water for the segment
items.non_grid_substitute: Gravity storage (towers, elevated tanks), hand pump on shallow well, windmill refill, boiling (needs heat/fuel)
items.local_holder: Households with hand-pump wells; towns with elevated storage
items.trigger: threshold: storage below set days of demand
items.note: Municipal water depends on L1 power and L2 chemicals; LEVEL CHECK flags this on purpose.

items.name: Sanitation
items.function: Remove human waste without contaminating water
items.non_grid_substitute: Gravity septic (no power); compost or pit latrine
items.trigger: threshold: lift-station wet-well level
items.note: Mandated sewer connection replaces no-power septic with pumps at the house and plant (source doc, section 3).

items.name: Insulin cold chain
items.function: Keep insulin within usable temperature for dependent people
items.non_grid_substitute: Evaporative cooling; winter outdoor storage with freeze protection
items.trigger: threshold: days of insulin on hand per dependent person
items.note: Stability window not entered; take it from the product label for the stock actually held.

items.name: Home oxygen
items.function: Supplemental oxygen for dependent people
items.non_grid_substitute: Compressed oxygen cylinders (finite; refill needs transport)
items.trigger: threshold: cylinder hours remaining per person
items.note: Concentrators need power; cylinder duration depends on size and flow.

items.name: Dialysis
items.function: Scheduled dialysis for dependent people
items.trigger: threshold: hours since last session per patient
items.note: No non-grid substitute recorded; candidate single point of failure.

items.name: Household non-grid buffer
items.function: The household holds without the worker and without grid for the restoration duration: own heat, stored or hand-pumped water, gravity septic, care of dependents
items.trigger: threshold: household buffer duration below restoration duration -> worker not deployable
items.note: Breaks the loop people_deployable -> municipal water -> generation -> people_deployable. Deployability rests on the household's own fallback, not on town services. Buffer duration is the denominator; survey per worker's dependency network.

items.name: Fuel stock
items.function: Diesel, gasoline, propane on hand for generation, pumps and transport
items.non_grid_substitute: Biodiesel blend (B20) from rendering fat or used cooking oil; B100 gels in Minnesota winter
items.local_holder: Farm tanks, fuel dealers, rail yards
items.trigger: threshold: days of fuel remaining at set level -> shed to essentials
items.note: Single point of failure named in source doc: the first fuel stock before local power.

items.name: Non-grid fuel transfer pumps
items.function: Move fuel out of tanks without grid power (breaks the pumps-need-power / power-needs-fuel loop)
items.non_grid_substitute: Gravity drain from elevated tank; hand rotary pump
items.trigger: action: switch to hand or 12V transfer when station pumps go dark

items.name: Self-starting diesel generation
items.function: First power for critical loads
items.local_holder: Hospitals, treatment plants, farms with standby sets
items.trigger: threshold: fuel days remaining

items.name: Dormant / disconnected hydro
items.function: Local island power without fuel
items.local_holder: Owners of dormant dams (USACE NID, ORNL non-powered dam assessment are data leads)
items.trigger: action: rehab gates, penstocks and turbine with locally made parts
items.note: Needs L2 knowledge holders (millwrights, operators); LEVEL CHECK flags this on purpose.

items.name: Mill / industrial on-site generation
items.function: Island nearby feeders from industrial plants
items.trigger: action: island plant and pick up adjacent feeders in small blocks

items.name: Biogas generation (treatment-plant digesters)
items.function: Run treatment-plant loads on its own digester gas
items.non_grid_substitute: Wood-fired hot-water boiler for digester heat
items.local_holder: Treatment plants with digesters and dual-fuel gensets
items.trigger: threshold: diesel days remaining -> route biogas to dual-fuel gensets
items.note: Islanded winter energy balance for a mid-size US plant is an open gap.*

items.name: Starting energy
items.function: Crank the first engine or turbine (battery, compressed air, hand crank)
items.non_grid_substitute: Hand crank; compressed-air bottle; pony engine
items.trigger: threshold: battery state of charge

items.name: Off-grid comms
items.function: Coordinate crews and communities without cell or internet
items.trigger: action: open scheduled radio nets and runner routes

items.name: Transport
items.function: Move fuel, parts, crews, food (vehicles, rail, roads)
items.non_grid_substitute: Steam rail (no grid, no diesel); horses and hand carts
items.local_holder: Heritage rail crews; farms with draft animals
items.trigger: threshold: diesel at set level -> consists to staging sidings

items.name: Deployable people
items.function: Workers who can leave home because the household holds without them for the duration
items.trigger: handoff: cover the worker's dependency network before callout
items.note: Variable is DEPLOYABILITY, not headcount; not recorded anywhere; checkable by survey.

items.name: Large power transformers
items.function: Replace failed transmission/substation transformers
items.trigger: action: inventory spares before the event

items.name: Breakers
items.function: Interrupt fault current; switch blocks for cold load pickup
items.trigger: action: inventory spares before the event

items.name: Protective relays
items.function: Detect faults and trip breakers
items.trigger: action: inventory spares before the event

items.name: SCADA / substation batteries
items.function: Keep control, protection and telemetry alive
items.non_grid_substitute: Manual switching by crews on site
items.trigger: threshold: battery hours remaining
items.note: Source doc: comms and SCADA run on hours of battery; hours not entered.

items.name: Water-treatment chemicals (chlorine)
items.function: Disinfect drinking water
items.trigger: threshold: days of chemical on hand

items.name: Knowledge holders
items.function: Old timers and operators: dam and boiler operators, millwrights, patternmakers, molders, machinists, linemen
items.non_grid_substitute: Filmed walkthroughs, drawings and foundry patterns captured BEFORE the event
items.local_holder: Retired operators; threshermen and steam clubs; heritage rail; Navy BT/MM veterans
items.trigger: debt: capture knowledge now; holders are aging out
items.note: Single point of failure named in source doc.

items.name: Synchronizing equipment
items.function: Match frequency, voltage and phase before tying two islands
items.non_grid_substitute: Manual synchroscope / lamp method by an experienced operator
items.trigger: handoff: tie islands only with both operators on the line

items.name: Protection settings for island operation
items.function: Relay settings valid for small, weak islands (not grid-normal settings)
items.trigger: action: pre-compute island settings before the event

items.name: Frequency authority agreement
items.function: Agree which island holds frequency when two tie
items.trigger: handoff: frequency-holding island named before tie

items.name: Pre-event trust and exchange agreements
items.function: What each community will send, receive and protect, agreed before the event
items.trigger: action: sign and drill agreements before the event
items.note: Local first, then outward: a stock the town draws from first gives every locality something to protect.

items.name: Government / military restoration (parallel input)
items.function: Outside help if and when it arrives
items.trigger: handoff: absorb into local plan when it arrives; plan never waits on it
items.note: Optional parallel input, never a prerequisite. chain.py fails any item that depends on it.
